decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete eight-clip batch source constraint and restores the general trial-clips context; the permitted source collection and source exclusion rule remain unchanged.
Reducing the current trial submission from eight clips to one reference-matching clip does not change the separate post-trial target of 180 approved clips per month.
The source changes the number and reference-matching nature of the requested trial submission but does not replace or relax the substantive-moment selection standard.
The request for one clip matching the supplied reference does not explicitly alter the existing clean, simple, professional editing rule or its prohibited visual treatments.
The source does not mention or necessarily change the hook-selection criterion.
Requesting one reference-matching clip does not change the requirement that each clip present a complete, independently understandable lesson or story.
The source contains no explicit change to the white-text-only or no-text-effects standards.
Changing the trial batch to one clip does not alter the existing 20-to-120-second duration requirement.
The source does not specify a different caption font or otherwise change the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
